definitions.gloss: maternal side, mother's side of the family
definitions.explanation: The relatives and lineage on one's mother's side. Used when distinguishing between maternal and paternal family connections.

examples.japanese: {母方|ははかた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{九十歳|きゅうじっさい}だ。
examples.english: My maternal grandmother is ninety years old.

examples.japanese: {母方|ははかた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{親戚|しんせき}→親戚：03260_shinseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: I have many relatives on my mother's side in Hokkaido.

examples.japanese: {母方|ははかた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家系|かけい}→家系：10130_kakei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧さん⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}いている→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I've heard that there are many doctors on my mother's side of the family.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {母方|ははかた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + family member. The most common combinations are with ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧ (grandfather), ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧ (grandmother), ⟦{親戚|しんせき}→親戚：03260_shinseki⟧ (relatives), and ⟦{家系|かけい}→家系：10130_kakei⟧ (family line).

CONTRASTING TERM:
- ⟦{父方|ちちかた}→父方：15830_chichikata⟧: paternal side, father's side of the family

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {母方|ははかた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧: maternal grandfather
- {母方|ははかた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧: maternal grandmother
- {母方|ははかた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{親戚|しんせき}→親戚：03260_shinseki⟧: maternal relatives
- {母方|ははかた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家系|かけい}→家系：10130_kakei⟧: maternal family line
